headlines.title: 法国央行就债务问题发表声明，驳斥“虚假信息”
headlines.summary: 法国央行发表声明，否认其在市场上出售了债务持仓，此前该央行遭到让-吕克·梅朗雄及其极左翼政党的批评。 该声明是对埃里克·科克雷尔言论的回应，后者称法国央行持有的证券投资组合出现了“令人担忧”的缩减。 法国央行表示，“自收购以来，这些证券均未在市场上出售”，并愿意向国民议会财政委员会解释其货币政策操作。

headlines.title_en: France's central bank issues a statement on debt issues, refuting 'false information'
headlines.summary_en: The Bank of France issued a statement denying that it had sold debt holdings in the market, after the central bank came under criticism from Jean-Luc Mélenchon and his far-left party. The statement was a response to remarks by Eric Coquerel, who said the securities portfolio held by the Bank of France had shrunk in a "worrying" way. The Bank of France said that "since acquisition, none of these securities have been sold on the market," and that it was willing to explain its monetary policy operations to the National Assembly's finance committee.

The producer price index rose 3.8 per cent year on year last month, up from 3.5 per cent in July, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Wednesday.
The reading beat a 3.6 per cent projection from economists polled by financial data provider Wind.

headlines.summary: 2026年9月7日，中国-世界银行集团全球生态系统与转型中心以“从愿景到行动：修复自然生态 促进繁荣发展”为主题，在北京举办“两山”理念高级别研讨会。财政部副部长廖岷出席会议开幕式并致辞。廖岷表示，中方呼吁世界银行等多边开发银行为发展中国家加强生态保护提供更多资金、技术和知识，并期待全球中心发挥好知识分享平台作用，提供更多全球公共产品。（财政部）

headlines.title_en: Liao Min attends the China-World Bank Group Global Ecosystem and Transformation Center high-level seminar on the 'Two Mountains' concept
headlines.summary_en: On September 7, 2026, the China-World Bank Group Global Ecosystem and Transformation Center held in Beijing a high-level seminar on the "Two Mountains" concept under the theme "From Vision to Action: Restoring Natural Ecosystems to Promote Prosperity and Development." Vice Minister of Finance Liao Min attended the opening ceremony and delivered remarks. Liao Min said that China calls on multilateral development banks such as the World Bank to provide more funding, technology, and knowledge to developing countries to strengthen ecological protection, and looks forward to the global center playing a good role as a knowledge-sharing platform and providing more global public goods. (Ministry of Finance)

headlines.summary: 【中国银行启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动 为算力产业链提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持】2026中国算力大会期间，中国银行在工业和信息化部、中国人民银行指导支持下，会同中国电信、中国移动、中国联通、中国人民保险、中国东方资产、国银金融租赁等生态伙伴，共同启动“一网三融”算力金融生态共建行动。“十五五”期间，中国银行将携手保险、产业投资、资产管理和金融租赁等算力生态伙伴，共建“算力+”产业金融生态，为算力产业链上下游企业提供不少于3000亿元综合金融支持，支持不少于100个重点智算中心项目，为国家算力互联互通区域节点提供跨区域、一体化协同金融服务，赋能3000家以上用算企业。

headlines.title_en: Bank of China launches 'One Network, Three Integrations' computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative, to provide no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support for the computing power industry chain
headlines.summary_en: [Bank of China launches the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative, providing no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support for the computing power industry chain] During the 2026 China Computing Power Conference, Bank of China, under the guidance and support of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the People's Bank of China, together with ecosystem partners including China Telecom, China Mobile, China Unicom, PICC, China Orient Asset Management, and CDB Financial Leasing, jointly launched the "One Network, Three Integrations" computing power financial ecosystem co-building initiative. During the 15th Five-Year Plan period, Bank of China will work with computing power ecosystem partners in insurance, industrial investment, asset management, and financial leasing to jointly build a "computing power+" industrial finance ecosystem, provide no less than RMB 300 billion in comprehensive financial support to upstream and downstream enterprises in the computing power industry chain, support no fewer than 100 key intelligent computing center projects, provide cross-regional, integrated coordinated financial services for national computing power interconnection regional nodes, and empower more than 3,000 computing-using enterprises.

headlines.title_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (summary): affirms the work of the 7 special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirms the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation and talent training
headlines.summary_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting (Summary): Affirmed the work of the seven special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirmed the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in areas such as smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation, and talent training. Recognized that artificial intelligence provides enormous opportunities for promoting economic growth and achieving sustainable development. Pointed out that using artificial intelligence to promote economic growth and social well-being is crucial for advancing countries, especially Global South countries, toward a just, fair, equal, and prosperous future. Affirmed the Shanghai World AI Conference and the High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance, and recognized their contributions to strengthening international AI cooperation and AI for good. (Xinhua News Agency)

The futurist Roy Amara is often credited with the observation that people tend to overestimate the short-term effect of a transformation while underestimating its long-term impact. China’s real-estate sector is furnishing a textbook case of an analogous dynamic.

headlines.title: 中信建投：加息“靴子”将落地，A股或迎反攻行情
headlines.summary: 中信建投研报表示，对于当前的A股和美股来说，加息预期的分歧让投资者感到无所适从，而加息“靴子落地”则能够凝聚共识，开启新一轮行情。本周五A股在四大利空冲击下实现V型反弹，结合未来美联储加息靴子将落地，A股周四大幅缩量和科技板块相对充分的调整，中信建投认为A股有望迎来变盘时点，或将开启反攻行情。配置上依然均衡配置+灵活调整：1.以通信、电子等高景气行业作为当前进攻核心品种，并适当调升仓位；2.以银行、保险等低估值红利板块作为防御性底仓品种；3.关注油气开采、煤化工、煤炭、油服工程、航运港口在高油价持续下的受益机会。

headlines.title_en: CSC Financial: The "other shoe" of rate hikes will drop, A-shares may see a counteroffensive rally
headlines.summary_en: A CITIC Securities research report stated that for current A-shares and U.S. stocks, disagreement over rate hike expectations has left investors unsure of what to do, while the rate hike "shoe dropping" can build consensus and start a new round of market movement. On Friday this week, A-shares achieved a V-shaped rebound under the impact of four major negative factors. Combined with the upcoming landing of the Federal Reserve rate hike, the sharp shrinkage in A-share trading volume on Thursday, and the relatively sufficient adjustment in the technology sector, CITIC Securities believes A-shares are expected to usher in a turning point and may start a counterattack. In terms of allocation, still use balanced allocation plus flexible adjustment: 1. Use high-prosperity industries such as communications and electronics as the core offensive varieties at present, and appropriately increase positions; 2. Use low-valuation dividend sectors such as banks and insurance as defensive base positions; 3. Pay attention to benefiting opportunities in oil and gas extraction, coal chemical industry, coal, oilfield services and engineering, and shipping and ports under sustained high oil prices.

headlines.title: 瑞典议会选举开始投票
headlines.summary: 金十数据9月13日讯，瑞典议会选举13日上午开始投票。此次选举将产生新一届全国议会，并影响未来瑞典政府组成和政策走向。瑞典广播电台12日公布的大选前最后一轮民调结果显示，社会民主党以28.6%的支持率位居第一；普遍被认为属极右翼的瑞典民主党支持率为18.3%，位居第二；现任首相乌尔夫·克里斯特松领导的温和党以16.8%的支持率位居第三。瑞典议会共有349个议席，每4年举行一次选举。

headlines.title_en: Sweden's parliamentary election voting begins
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, September 13 - Voting in Sweden's parliamentary election began on the morning of September 13. This election will produce a new national parliament and affect the future composition of the Swedish government and policy direction. The final pre-election poll released by Swedish Radio on the 12th showed that the Social Democrats ranked first with 28.6% support; the Sweden Democrats, widely regarded as far-right, ranked second with 18.3% support; and the Moderate Party led by incumbent Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson ranked third with 16.8% support. Sweden's parliament has 349 seats, with elections held every 4 years.

headlines.title: 上海“明珠星座计划”正式启动，目标建设吉瓦级天基计算星座
headlines.summary: 9月13日，2026浦江创新论坛“太空算力产业生态论坛”在上海举行。“明珠星座计划”正式启动。该计划长期目标是建设吉瓦级天基计算星座，围绕国产算力载荷、光计算载荷、新型能源系统等方向开展在轨验证，随后逐步进入首批卫星部署和规模组网阶段，计划到2030年逐步建成全球覆盖、天地协同、自主可控的太空智能算力基础设施和服务网络。

headlines.title_en: Shanghai's "Pearl Constellation Plan" officially launched, aiming to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation
headlines.summary_en: On September 13, the 2026 Pujiang Innovation Forum "Space Computing Power Industry Ecosystem Forum" was held in Shanghai. The "Pearl Constellation Plan" was officially launched. The plan's long-term goal is to build a gigawatt-level space-based computing constellation, carry out in-orbit verification around domestic computing power payloads, optical computing payloads, new energy systems, and other directions, then gradually enter the stage of initial satellite deployment and large-scale networking, and plan to gradually build a globally covered, space-ground coordinated, independently controllable space intelligent computing power infrastructure and service network by 2030.

headlines.title: 我国实现一体化算力统筹监测
headlines.summary: 从工业和信息化部了解到，中国算力平台已实现全国一体化算力统筹监测，我国算力“一张网、一盘棋、一体化”发展格局基本形成。中国算力平台是国家级综合性算力服务平台，目前已经汇聚了超万家注册企业用户，上架2000多项优质算力产品，接入各类大模型超300个，为广大开发者提供算力调用服务，累计沉淀数十亿条算力监测大数据。（央视新闻）

headlines.title_en: China achieves integrated coordinated monitoring of computing power
headlines.summary_en: Learned from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology that China's computing power platform has achieved nationwide integrated computing power coordinated monitoring, and the development pattern of "one network, one chessboard, integration" for China's computing power has basically taken shape. China's computing power platform is a national-level comprehensive computing power service platform. It has currently gathered more than 10,000 registered enterprise users, listed more than 2,000 high-quality computing power products, connected more than 300 large models of various types, provided computing power invocation services for developers, and accumulated billions of pieces of computing power monitoring big data. (CCTV News)

headlines.title: 中国工程院院士邬贺铨：2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%
headlines.summary: 在9月12日2026中国算力大会主论坛上，中国工程院院士邬贺铨指出，智能体的出现带动了Token的消费。今年3月，Token的消费已经达到日均140万亿。随着技术进步，Token的消耗并不是以多为荣，而是以效率为荣。中国Token的应用成本不断下降，这也促进了Token的利用。Token带动算力，算力和Token之间成正比。目前，中国的算力在全球占21%，美国占46%，按照国家算力网的规划，2030年中国算力有望占到全球30%。

headlines.title_en: Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan: China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030
headlines.summary_en: At the main forum of the 2026 China Computing Conference on September 12, Chinese Academy of Engineering academician Wu Hequan pointed out that the emergence of intelligent agents has driven Token consumption. In March this year, Token consumption had already reached an average of 140 trillion per day. As technology advances, Token consumption is not about taking pride in using more, but about taking pride in efficiency. The application cost of Tokens in China continues to decline, which has also promoted Token utilization. Tokens drive computing power, and computing power and Tokens are directly proportional. At present, China accounts for 21% of global computing power, while the United States accounts for 46%. According to the national computing power network plan, China's computing power is expected to account for 30% of the global total by 2030.

headlines.summary_en: [The 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting concluded in Beijing] On September 11, the 16th APEC Energy Ministerial Meeting concluded in Beijing. The meeting closely followed the overall theme of the 2026 APEC "China Year," "Building an Asia-Pacific Community, Promoting Common Prosperity," with the energy sector theme of "Building an Inclusive, Innovative, and Collaborative Asia-Pacific Energy Community." Ding Xuexiang, member of the Standing Committee of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Vice Premier of the State Council, attended the opening ceremony and delivered a speech.
